incident-bot: [ALERT] Error budget burn alert: hosted-api-eu (service: inference-proxy)
incident-bot: Triggered 2026-03-16T08:02:47Z; 5xx spike 2.8% over baseline, error budget burn 4% in last 10m
Maya Singh: I'm oncall, taking it. Opening SLO dashboard and logs now: https://dash.redwood.internal/slo/inference-proxy
Maya Singh: Ethan, any deploys or routing changes in eu region in the last hour?
Ethan Park: No deploys from infra, but there was a config push to the feature-flag service at 07:50 UTC that updated the header rewrite rule. Could be related.
Sara Gomez: customer monitoring thinks probes started failing around 08:00 UTC. They reported retries in their app.
Maya Singh: Triage plan: 1) reduce incoming load to canary pool 2) failover canary traffic to stable 3) enable extra tracing for proxy
Maya Singh: applying traffic shift to stable...
pd-bot: Change request submitted: traffic-shift/inference-proxy-eu -> 60% stable, 40% canary (initiated by Maya)
Maya Singh: shift applied. 5xx fell to 0.7% within 2 min but we still see short bursts.
Ethan Park: I'm going to revert the header rewrite in feature-flag svc to previous rule (rollback id ff-20260316-01).
pd-bot: Rollback completed: feature-flag/ff-20260316-01 -> success
Maya Singh: good. 5xx now ~0.2% and SLO looks healthy. Marking state: mitigated -> monitoring.
Maya Singh: Handing over to Sara for post-incident follow-up. Handoff notes: cause likely header rewrite causing upstream 502s; mitigations applied: traffic shift + rollback. Customers affected: several EU customers experienced transient errors for ~12m. Severity set to P2.
Sara Gomez: taking over. I'll keep watch for 20m and then create follow-up tasks.
Sara Gomez: Observations: alerts paged on two rules: "Proxy5xxSpike" (paged immediately) and "ProxyErrorBudgetBurn" (paged). Both fired on short-lived spikes. We need to reduce noise.
Ethan Park: Agreed. Current page rules don't consider request volume nor minimum duration. For low-traffic tenants a tiny spike creates a page.
Sara Gomez: Proposed change: make Proxy5xxSpike only page when both conditions met: sustained >1.5% for 10m AND total requests > 1k in window. Else file ticket with severity low. Also make ErrorBudgetBurn alert ticket-only unless burn >5% in 30m.
Sara Gomez: Draft Prom rule for Proxy5xxSpike:
```
alert: Proxy5xxSpike
expr: sum(rate(proxy_responses_total{code=~\"5..\",region=\"eu\"}[10m])) / sum(rate(proxy_responses_total{region=\"eu\"}[10m])) > 0.015
  and sum(rate(proxy_responses_total{region=\"eu\"}[10m])) > 1000
for: 10m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  summary: "EU proxy 5xx rate >1.5% for 10m and volume >1k"
```
Sara Gomez: And update Alertmanager mapping so that alerts labeled severity: page route to pagerduty team `eng-oncall` then escalate to `eng-sre` after 8m; alerts labeled severity: ticket go to #incidents (no page).
Ethan Park: Also add alert grouping key to group by region+model_pool so one incident per region/pool rather than flood.
Maya Singh: +1 on grouping. Add a dedupe window in PagerDuty so similar alerts within 15m merge into one page.
ops-rotation: I'll add a dashboard tile showing 5xx by model_pool and overlay deploys/feature-flag changes. Link: https://dash.redwood.internal/d/alerts/5xx-modelpool
Sara Gomez: Runbook change: add decision tree: "If 5xx spike coincides with recent FF change -> rollback FF first; if unrelated, rate-limit model pool and failover". Also add explicit paging policy: "page only for sustained+high-volume; ticket for transient or low-volume."
Ethan Park: I'll open PR for Prom + Alertmanager + PagerDuty config changes with the adjusted thresholds and grouping. Assigning to Sara for review.
Sara Gomez: I'll review and push to staging. Also scheduling a 30-min postmortem sync tomorrow at 09:30 to capture timeline and customer impact. Postmortem doc: https://incidents.redwood.internal/INC-4898
Maya Singh: Action items recap: 1) PR for alert and routing changes (Ethan) 2) Dashboard panel for model_pool/5xx (ops-rotation) 3) Runbook edits (ops-rotation + Sara) 4) Postmortem doc & customer impact notes (Sara)
Sara Gomez: Also recommend we add an automated test in CI that simulates header rewrite changes against a local proxy to detect 502 regressions during FF deploys.
Ethan Park: noted. I'll add a ticket to infra backlog and tag it high priority.
incident-bot: Incident INC-4898 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Postmortem scheduled.
Maya Singh: Thanks team. Leaving Slack thread and incident doc updated. Back to rotation. :thumbsup:
